background_story: Tomas was a quiet, unassuming man who lived near a small lake. Every year, a flock of geese would migrate to the lake, and Tomas would eagerly await their arrival. He'd spend hours observing the geese, fascinated by their V-formation flights and honking calls. One year, a lone goose, injured during migration, was left behind by its flock. Tomas took the goose in, nursing it back to health and naming it Gracie. As Gracie recovered, Tomas and the goose formed an unlikely bond. Tomas learned to mimic the goose's calls, and Gracie would follow him everywhere. The locals began to call Tomas the 'Goose Whisperer.' As the years passed, Tomas and Gracie became inseparable, with Tomas learning valuable lessons about loyalty, perseverance, and the beauty of unexpected friendships.
